hint: Use bounds with 0 <= start <= end <= length: the end is exclusive, so `arr[0..length]` is the whole array, and a negative bound counts from the end (`arr[-2..]` is the last 2 elements).
label: this range is outside the array
message: The slice `[1..4]` of `int[3]` is out of range: the end is outside 0..3.
